question: OPS06
title: Plan for unsuccessful changes
recommendation: Add a rollback section to the pull request template, require backward-compatible (expand and contract) schema changes, and keep the previous task definition revision ready to redeploy.

question: SEC02
title: Use temporary credentials
recommendation: Replace the ci-deployer key with GitHub OIDC federation to an IAM role scoped to the repository and the production environment, then deactivate and delete the key.

question: REL09
title: Perform periodic recovery of the data to verify backup integrity and processes
recommendation: Restore the latest snapshot into the staging account every quarter, time it, check row counts, and record the result next to the recovery runbook.

question: REL13
title: Define recovery objectives for downtime and data loss
recommendation: Agree an RTO and RPO for checkout and order history with the business owner, and record them in the workload's operations document.

question: OPS06
title: Automate testing and rollback
recommendation: Enable the ECS deployment circuit breaker with rollback, and add a post-deploy smoke test and a CloudWatch alarm on the checkout KPI that stops and reverts the deployment.

question: SEC03
title: Grant least privilege access
recommendation: Give the new deploy role only the ECS, ECR and Terraform state permissions it uses, move people to IAM Identity Center permission sets, and enforce MFA.

question: REL06
title: Monitor all components for the workload (Generation)
recommendation: Add alarms for the dead-letter queue depth, Aurora CPU and connections, Lambda errors and throttles, and a CloudWatch Synthetics canary on the checkout path.

question: REL10
title: Deploy the workload to multiple locations
recommendation: Add an Aurora reader in a second Availability Zone so failover takes about a minute, and enable Multi-AZ with automatic failover on ElastiCache.

question: DL.ADS
title: Implement automatic rollbacks for failed deployments
recommendation: Use the circuit breaker and alarm-based rollback from OPS06-BP04 for every service, including the Lambda fulfilment worker through CodeDeploy traffic shifting with alarms.

question: OPS04
title: Identify key performance indicators
recommendation: Agree three KPIs with the business (checkout success rate, p95 checkout latency, orders sent to the logistics partner within five minutes) and publish them on one CloudWatch dashboard.

question: OPS07
title: Use runbooks to perform procedures
recommendation: Write runbooks for the five most frequent procedures, keep them next to the code, and link each alarm to its runbook.

question: OPS10
title: Use a process for event, incident, and problem management
recommendation: Define three severity levels, an incident lead role and a status page update rule, and page the on-call engineer from CloudWatch alarms.

question: OPS11
title: Perform post-incident analysis
recommendation: Write a blameless analysis for every SEV1 and SEV2 incident within five working days and track its actions in the team backlog.

question: SEC02
title: Store and use secrets securely
recommendation: Move the partner token to Secrets Manager, inject it through the task definition `secrets` field, and set a rotation reminder or automatic rotation.

question: SEC04
title: Configure service and application logging
recommendation: Enable ALB access logs to S3 and export the Aurora PostgreSQL log, each with a retention period that matches the investigation needs.

question: SEC06
title: Perform vulnerability management
recommendation: Route Inspector critical and high findings to the team channel, rebuild images weekly on a patched base image, and fail the pipeline on critical findings that have a fix.

question: SEC10
title: Develop incident management plans
recommendation: Write a one-page security incident plan (roles, contacts, first actions for a leaked key) and rehearse it once as a tabletop exercise.

question: REL07
title: Use automation when obtaining or scaling resources
recommendation: Add target tracking scaling to orders-api on CPU and on ALB requests per target, with a minimum of three tasks across three Availability Zones.

question: COST03
title: Add organization information to cost and usage
recommendation: Activate the tags for cost allocation, add default_tags to the Terraform AWS provider, and add a tag policy in AWS Organizations.

question: O.CM
title: Conduct post-incident analysis for continuous improvement
recommendation: Delivered by OPS11-BP02; review open actions in the weekly operations review.

question: QA.ST
title: Enhance source code security with static application security testing
recommendation: Delivered by SEC11-BP02; track it here so the DevOps lens score reflects it.

question: QA.ST
title: Validate third-party components using software composition analysis
recommendation: Add dependency scanning to pull requests and enable Dependabot security updates on all repositories.

question: OPS05
title: Test and validate changes
recommendation: Run unit tests for all three services on every pull request, and add a migration test that applies each schema change to a copy of the staging database.

question: OPS05
title: Fully automate integration and deployment
recommendation: Promote the same image from staging to production in one pipeline, run migrations as a pipeline step, and keep the manual approval as the only human action.

question: OPS06
title: Employ safe deployment strategies
recommendation: Use ECS blue/green deployments through CodeDeploy, or at least rolling updates with minimumHealthyPercent 100 and the deployment circuit breaker enabled.

question: SEC11
title: Automate testing throughout the development and release lifecycle
recommendation: Add Semgrep, dependency scanning and Checkov to pull request checks, starting in report-only mode and failing on new high findings after two weeks.

question: PERF05
title: Load test your workload
recommendation: Build a repeatable load test of the checkout path in staging and run it before every planned campaign; add a campaign calendar that engineering can see.

question: COST06
title: Select resource type, size, and number automatically based on metrics
recommendation: Right-size tasks from Container Insights data, scale staging to zero outside working hours, and review AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations each month.

question: DL.ADS
title: Use staggered deployment and release strategies
recommendation: After blue/green is in place, shift traffic in steps (for example 10 percent for ten minutes) and release risky features behind flags.

question: DL.CD
title: Automate the entire deployment process
recommendation: Once the promotion pipeline from OPS05-BP10 exists, trigger production deployments from the approved staging build without any manual command.

question: DL.EAC
title: Organize infrastructure as code for scale
recommendation: Import the console-built resources, split state per environment and per stack, and run plan on every pull request with drift detection each night.

question: O.SI
title: Instrument all systems for comprehensive telemetry data collection
recommendation: Adopt structured JSON logs with a request ID and add OpenTelemetry tracing through the AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry collector to AWS X-Ray.

question: QA.FT
title: Ensure individual component functionality with unit tests
recommendation: Cover checkout, payment status handling and the fulfilment message format first, and fail the build when the tests fail.

question: REL13
title: Use defined recovery strategies to meet the recovery objectives
recommendation: Choose a strategy that meets the agreed objectives (backup and restore with cross-Region copies is likely enough), then document and test it.

question: OPS08
title: Analyze workload metrics
recommendation: Hold a 30-minute weekly operations review of the KPI dashboard and the alarm history.

question: PERF02
title: Collect compute-related metrics
recommendation: Enable Container Insights on the production cluster and add memory utilization to the dashboard.

question: COST02
title: Implement cost controls
recommendation: Create a budget per environment with alerts at 80 and 100 percent of forecast, sent to a team distribution list.

question: COST04
title: Decommission resources
recommendation: Remove the idle resources after confirming with their owners, and review unused resources monthly.

question: COST07
title: Perform pricing model analysis
recommendation: After right-sizing, buy a Compute Savings Plan for the steady baseline and consider Aurora reserved instances for the writer.

question: SUS02
title: Scale workload infrastructure dynamically
recommendation: Apply the scaling and staging schedule from REL07-BP01 and COST06-BP03.

question: SUS04
title: Use policies to manage the lifecycle of your datasets
recommendation: Add S3 lifecycle rules for noncurrent versions and set retention on every log group (for example 30 days for application logs and longer where investigations need it).

question: DL.CD
title: Refine delivery pipelines using metrics for continuous improvement
recommendation: Publish deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate and time to restore from the pipeline and the incident log each month, and review the trend in the operations review.

question: DL.SCM
title: Keep feature branches short-lived
recommendation: Merge to main behind feature flags and deploy from main, retiring the release branches.

question: REL12
title: Test resiliency using chaos engineering
recommendation: Once alarms and Multi-AZ are in place, run an AWS Fault Injection Service experiment in staging that stops the Aurora writer, with a written hypothesis and stop conditions.

question: PERF01
title: Use benchmarking to drive architectural decisions
recommendation: Benchmark orders-api on Graviton-based Fargate tasks against the current x86 tasks with the load test from PERF05-BP04, and keep the faster or cheaper option.
